notes.title: [Patch Note] 0.0.3 Demo version
notes.notes: [p]We have improved the overall combat feel and feedback, and the core logic has been updated so that doors remain sealed until a chest is opened when moving between modules.[/p][p]NPC AI and visuals have been updated, and players can now acquire a wider variety of Artifacts. Additionally, acquired Artifacts now have greater visual impact on both the player and their weapon.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Enemy Balancing[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemies could not properly climb stairs[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced health and increased summon count for standard NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted NPC death behavior so that they are thrown farther upon defeat[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Abyss of Yggdrasil[/h3][list][*][p]Map name changed to [b]Wretched Rest[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Foolish Wisp[/b]: Now explodes instantly upon death[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Forgotten Temple[/h3][list][*][p][b]Victorious Loser[/b]: Fixed an issue where the boss would freeze after performing a jump attack[/p][/*][*][p][b]Magnusson the Blasphemer[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the boss would land incorrectly after a ground slam[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the boss failed to properly target players when at a distance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed other issues causing the boss to remain idle unexpectedly[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p]All doors in a module are now sealed upon entry. They can only be opened after unlocking the chest.[/p][/*][*][p]Markers on the minimap, which were previously always visible, are now only activated when the player is within a certain distance.[/p][p](For example, chests will only appear on the minimap once you approach them.)[/p][/*][*][p]Added more diverse Artifacts with unique mechanics, such as lifesteal, health regeneration, and auto-reload.[/p][/*][*][p]Artifact acquisition now applies more visible attachments to the player and their shotgun. Equipping items such as boots or gloves will visually alter the character’s hands and feet.[/p][/*][*][p]The overall layout of the [b]Forgotten Temple[/b] has been adjusted, with a first pass of visual polish applied.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Wretched Rest[/b] now features a wider variety of dungeon modules.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a twin-cat NPC to the shop (interactions to be added in a future update).[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439595/351c12e61eda1c7936df1fd5518b6c035bb916f3.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Steam Cloud saves could fail[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed locations in certain maps where players could get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected typos and revised some NPC dialogues[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted friendly fire ratios based on difficulty (including self-inflicted damage)[/p][/*][*][p]Other stability improvements and bug fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: [Patch Note] 0.0.2 Demo version
notes.notes: [p]We have identified and addressed several issues and improvements in the demo version.[/p][p]Thank you for enjoying our demo.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Balancing[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Tyr: \[Judgment Drive][/b] – Adjusted skill visuals and optimized collision handling[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tyr: \[Sacred Inferno][/b] – Optimized collision handling[/p][/*][*][p]Increased damage efficiency when additional [b]barrels[/b] are equipped[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Abyss of Yggdrasil[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Foolish Wisp:[/b] Fixed an issue where the unit would occasionally stop moving[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Forgotten Temple[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Magnusson the Blasphemer:[/b] Fixed an issue where the same pattern was repeated during Phase 3[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b][i]Steam Cloud[/i][/b] support for game saves[/p][/*][*][p]Changed key binding and added tutorial for [b]Hero Info Panel[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Previous[/b]: [b]\[~][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New[/b]: [b]\[C][/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed locations in certain maps where players could get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the selected blessing’s color displayed incorrectly in the [b]Altar of Bless[/b] UI[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected typos and revised certain NPC dialogues[/p][/*][*][p][b]Other build stability improvements[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]
